sectors.trend: Iron ore faces sustained downside pressure; gold exploration activity robust across WA and SA (Platina, Broken Hill, Forrestania, Great Southern 10.72g/t); Dalaroo advances Greenland rare earths; Larvotto first antimony-gold concentrate from NSW
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) under pressure from iron ore weakness; small/mid-cap gold and rare-earth explorers (PLA.AX, BHP.AX, DLR.AX, LRV.AX, FRA.AX) attract speculative interest; diversification into gold/rare earths offsets iron ore risk

sectors.trend: Super contributions surge >33% after budget tax changes; government-backed digital pension scheme proposed; super system criticised as 'not fit for purpose'; higher rates persist
sectors.implications: Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPU.AX, QAN.AX) benefit from inflows; banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face margin pressure from higher-for-longer rates; digital pension scheme could disrupt compulsory super model long-term

sectors.trend: Diesel and petrol shock rising; EV adoption accelerating as Australians 'flee the bowser'; oil weakness weighs on Wall Street and ASX
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) face mixed signals – oil weakness vs. gas demand; EV transition (BYD, Tesla) pressures traditional fuel retailers (WES.AX, IAG.AX); energy transition theme gains traction

sectors.trend: Consumer stress evident: Dollar General CEO raises red flag, Christmas retailer files Chapter 11, 80-yr discount chain closes 120 stores; airfares soaring ahead of grand final
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX, and retail REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face headwinds; consumer discretionary under pressure; defensive staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) may outperform

sectors.trend: Sydney housing 'bloodbath' with auction reality check; rental market disruption proposed (cutting out agents); fire ban concerns in regional areas
sectors.implications: Property trusts (VCG.AX, SGH.AX, DGL.AX) under pressure from falling values and rising rates; rental yield compression; potential policy shift on agent commissions could reshape sector economics

sectors.trend: CoreWeave raising AI compute prices; Interactive Brokers 77% pretax margin; Prudential exits emerging markets; Buffett steps down; AI-driven market dynamics
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but global AI capex cycle supports sentiment; Prudential's EM exit signals risk-off; Buffett succession at BRK.A signals generational shift in global capital allocation

Higher-for-longer rates reshaping financials and property
Super system reform: surging contributions, digital pension alternative, fitness-for-purpose debate
Consumer weakness: retail bankruptcies, discount chain closures, fuel cost shock
Global trade war (Trump) and 'four horsemen' macro risk
Ageing population fiscal drag per Intergenerational Report; baby bonus debate
Warren Buffett succession – global market leadership transition

Reduce REIT and property-linked exposure; favour defensive consumer staples; monitor RBA rate path

Reduce commodity export concentration; favour domestic-demand sectors; monitor AUD/USD

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare-earth explorers amid iron ore weakness
opportunities.rationale: Active exploration pipeline (WA gold, Greenland rare earths, NSW antimony-gold) offers asymmetric upside; gold hedges trade-war and rate uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Favour defensive consumer staples over discretionary retail
opportunities.rationale: Consumer stress (retail bankruptcies, fuel shock, discount closures) favours essential-goods names with pricing power

opportunities.recommendation: Selective financials: large-cap banks with strong NIM
opportunities.rationale: Higher rates support net interest margins; super contribution surge benefits fund managers; digital pension scheme is long-term tailwind for asset management

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and property REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore downside persists; Sydney housing in bloodbath; higher rates compress property valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge global trade-war and rate risk via AUD/USD and short-duration bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: Trump trade war and 'four horsemen' warning elevate tail risk; AUD vulnerable to commodity and rate shocks

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid consumer discretionary and transport-exposed names
defensive_moves.rationale: Fuel shock, retail bankruptcies, and airfare spikes signal consumer squeeze; discount chain closures indicate structural weakness

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months: iron ore weakness, higher rates, housing correction, and consumer stress dominate. Gold and rare-earth miners offer relative strength. RBA on hold but higher-for-longer caps upside. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a range with downside bias.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious: structural iron ore decline, ageing-population fiscal drag (Intergenerational Report), and super system reform create headwinds. Gold, healthcare (CSL.AX), and domestic-demand staples offer resilience. EV transition and AI capex provide selective growth pockets. Trade-war resolution would be a key positive catalyst.
